pages.title: Flagship Research Projects | Johan Ajnabi
pages.description: Flagship research projects by Johan Ajnabi spanning skin mechanobiology, spatial transcriptomics, keratinocyte stemness, and regenerative skin biology.

pages.title: DNMT3A Mechanotransduction in Wound Repair | Johan Ajnabi
pages.description: A flagship research project by Johan Ajnabi on how wound-induced mechanical cues regulate DNMT3A localization and epigenetic control during epidermal repair.

pages.title: Spatial Transcriptomics in Vitiligo Skin | Johan Ajnabi
pages.description: A flagship research project by Johan Ajnabi on how NB-UVB treatment reshapes the immune landscape in vitiligo skin using spatial transcriptomic analysis.

pages.title: Keratinocyte Stemness and Mindin-Integrin-STAT3 Signaling | Johan Ajnabi
pages.description: A flagship research project by Johan Ajnabi on how extracellular context, integrin trafficking, and downstream transcriptional programs help maintain keratinocyte stemness.
